where_to_look: 11 estimates on a $29bn name means the operating metrics are thoroughly modelled - the room here is narrow and a hunter should not spend its budget re-deriving billings. Focus instead on the FY2027 initial guide, which is what a Q4 print actually delivers and is the least-anchored number of the day for ZS

Federal: Zscaler's FedRAMP business and the US federal fiscal-year-end (30 September) buying cycle straddles this quarter and the next. Public federal contract-award data for the quarter is a genuine, under-used check on the government line

M&A integration: any acquisition closed in FY26 changes the organic-vs-inorganic ARR split, and the split is usually disclosed only under questioning on the call. The 8-K/S-4 record since the last print is the place
Unbilled/remaining performance obligation and the calculated-billings seasonality of a Q4 - ZS's Q4 is its largest billings quarter and small linearity shifts produce large optical beats or misses
13.15% implied move with a two-sided chain: the measurement quality here is high even if the informational room is low, which is what makes it worth a mid-ranked slot rather than a low one
